mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET last_login_time = NOW(), last_login_ip = #{loginIp}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET followers_count = #{followersCount}, following_count = #{followingCount}, posts_count = #{postsCount}, likes_count = #{likesCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET level = #{level}, experience = #{experience}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET points = points + #{points}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET is_verified = #{isVerified}, verified_type = #{verifiedType}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_user WHERE level = #{level} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_user WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND last_login_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY last_login_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM tb_user WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY points DESC, level DESC, experience DESC LIMIT #{limit}
